metric_definitions.documents_with_label_anchor: document contains an explicit visible semantic label for the field
metric_definitions.documents_with_anchored_value: production extractor returned a value and an explicit semantic label exists
metric_definitions.documents_with_extracted_value: production extractor returned found/ambiguous evidence; includes explicitly derived currency evidence
metric_definitions.format_only_unanchored_candidate: field-compatible format exists without an extracted value or explicit semantic anchor
metric_definitions.non_target_context_documents: field-like format is explicitly owned by another semantic context, e.g. NET WEIGHT is not GROSS WEIGHT
metric_definitions.unclassified_numeric_occurrences: plain numeric GT boxes not consumed by any extracted field evidence
metric_definitions.exclusive_document_status: mutually exclusive per-field partition; counts sum to the document count

exclusive_status_definitions.derived_value: self-describing/derived value without explicit target label (primarily currency)
exclusive_status_definitions.derived_ambiguous: derived evidence is ambiguous (e.g. currency symbol without ISO code)
exclusive_status_definitions.label_only: explicit label exists but no compatible value was deterministically attached
exclusive_status_definitions.format_only: compatible value format exists without target semantic label
exclusive_status_definitions.non_target_context: compatible format is visibly associated with a different semantic label/context
exclusive_status_definitions.missing: no target label, extracted value, or compatible unanchored format
exclusive_status_definitions.malformed: record structure could not be profiled
